_comment: Florida has no state income tax on wages.
name: Florida
notes: Florida's constitution prohibits a personal income tax, so nothing comes out of your pay for the state.
Florida leans on sales tax and tourism instead. If you moved here from a high-tax state, the difference shows up on your very first paycheck.
Florida has no state disability insurance program that takes money from your check. For most Florida employees, only federal tax and FICA come out.
This works as a Florida pay calculator for salary or hourly work. Switch between them at the top of the calculator.
